messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Restyle the person's hair to match the hairstyle shown in the reference images, using the front view for the front-facing shape and the back view for the back-facing shape. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use the video that was the input to the first camera change as the starting point, and make the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, initially facing left, then raises both arms to adjust her hair before turning her back to the camera and walking away.","camera":"The camera remains static at a medium-long distance, capturing the character from the side and then from behind as she moves.","clothing":"She wears a short, form-fitting dress with a pink and white checkered bodice, white off-the-shoulder sleeves, and a white and black asymmetrical skirt, paired with light blue slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Hair is pulled back into a low bun or ponytail at the nape of the neck.","identity":"A slender female character with fair skin, shown in a 3D rendered style.","scene":"The setting is a European-style street with cobblestone paving, brick and stone buildings, vintage shop signs, and black lampposts."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's hair now shows a low bun/ponytail at the nape and appears pulled back, but the reference's distinctive two low side buns and center braid are not clearly visible. The rest of the character, clothing, street scene, and motion remain largely the same.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the character's hair to match the reference images: front bangs with two low side buns, and a back view with a center braid leading to two low buns, while preserving blue hair color, identity, clothing, scene, and action.
uncertain: Whether the front-facing shape includes the reference's bangs and side buns, because the character's face is mostly turned away in the output frames.
